waypoints.name: Schriebers Meadow / Park Butte Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From WA-20 at milepost 82, turn north onto Baker Lake Road (FS Road 11) and drive 12.5 miles to just past the Rocky Creek bridge. Turn left on FS Road 12 for 3.6 miles, then stay right on FS Road 13 for 5.3 miles to its end at the Schriebers Meadow (Park Butte) trailhead, about 3,360 ft. Road 13 is potholed and rocky; high clearance helps. A Northwest Forest Pass is required.
